prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in step after adoption: Move sign-in to take place after pet selection and photo upload, allowing users to form an emotional attachment to their pet before creating an account. (why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) and sign-in drops 27.1% of users right at the beginning before they experience the pet.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Add desktop controls onboarding screen: Add a dedicated screen right before finish explaining desktop pet interactions, hiding, and sound controls. (why: Support inbox received multiple tickets from users confused about how to hide, control, or talk to their pet after setup.)
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive desktop preview flow during waiting screen: Add a multi-step interactive tutorial flow while the pet is loading on the waiting screen to teach controls. (why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to dropoff and post-onboarding control confusion.)
3: [home, wait_info] Add tip carousel to pet generation wait screen: Show an animated tip carousel and estimated time remaining on the waiting screen while pet assets render. (why: The waiting step has high friction with long average delays (mean 2336s), causing dropoff (81.3% conversion).)
4: [home, notification] Desktop ready notification prompt: Enable desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet generation finishes. (why: Mean waiting time is extremely long (2336s), leading users to wander away or close the app before finish.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Card grid layout for path choice screen: Switch choose_path layout to split card design with clear visual previews of pet customization paths. (why: Choose path takes a surprisingly long mean time (514s) and drops 23.8% of users on step 1.)
6: [finish, copy] Explicit desktop pet launching instructions on intro: Update welcome headline and add body copy clarifying how the pet will spawn on the desktop taskbar. (why: 3 support tickets cited pets not appearing on desktop or users not knowing if the app opened.)
